{{Quote|We gather beneath the four moons of Onderon, to perform a ceremony of Binding. Who among you bears witness to this great event?|Beast Rider Priest|audio=BindingCeremony-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi (audio)">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
A '''Binding Ceremony''' was a customary ritual performed by the [[Beast Riders]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], used to signify a life-long marriage commitment agreed upon by a man and a woman. Synonymous to a wedding, a ''Ceremony of Binding'' joined the two Onderonians together in matrimony, after the recital of vows from both the groom and bride.

==History==
In [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], a [[Binding Ceremony of Oron Kira and Galia|binding ceremony]] was performed for [[Beast-Lord]] [[Oron Kira]], and [[Galia]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]]. The ceremony was interrupted by three [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]], who, under orders from Galia's mother, Queen [[Amanoa]], were sent to retrieve her daughter from the clutches of the Beast Riders. Jedi Knights [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma]], [[Cay Qel-Droma]], and the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Tott Doneeta]], were surprised to find that Galia was being married to the Beast Lord, seemingly against her will. After a brief confrontation between them and the Beast Riders, it was discovered that the princess was not being forced to marry Oron Kira, but was doing so of her own accord.
